answer.question: What is a software testing internship at Icanio?
answer.answer: It is a mentored internship at Icanio Tech School where you learn quality assurance on real applications. You start with manual testing and test design, move to API testing with Postman, then build automation with Selenium, Playwright and pytest. You finish with a working test framework in a CI/CD pipeline, ISTQB-aligned knowledge and a certificate.

sections.heading: What a software tester does, and why QA skills are in demand
sections.intro: Every release carries risk. Software testers are the people who find the problems before customers do.
paragraphs: A software tester, or QA engineer, checks that an application does what it should and fails safely when it should not. You read requirements, design test cases, run them by hand or with scripts, and report defects clearly enough that a developer can fix them fast.

Modern QA is technical. Teams expect testers to call APIs, query databases, write automation code and plug tests into CI/CD pipelines so every change is checked automatically. Companies need these skills because a single bug in payments or login can cost far more than a testing team.

A software testing internship lets you practise this on real software, not textbook examples. In our software testing internship you test applications built from Icanio client scenarios, file real defect reports and build automation that runs on every push.
bullets: Design test cases from requirements and user stories
Run functional, regression, smoke and exploratory tests
Test APIs and databases, not just screens
Automate checks and run them in CI/CD pipelines

sections.heading: What you will learn in the software testing internship
sections.intro: The software testing internship runs in four phases, from manual QA to a full automation pipeline. Each phase ends with a mentor review of your test work.

items.label: Phase 1
items.title: Testing fundamentals and manual QA
points: SDLC, STLC and an overview of testing types and levels
Writing test plans, test cases and checklists from requirements
Functional, regression and smoke testing on a live application
Clear bug reporting in Jira and Bugzilla, with steps and evidence
Exploratory testing techniques to find what scripts miss

items.label: Phase 2
items.title: API testing and test design
points: REST API testing with Postman: requests, status codes and responses
Test design techniques such as boundary values and equivalence classes
API automation with Newman and Postman collections
Error handling checks, mocks, stubs and test data management
Database testing and data validation with SQL queries

items.label: Phase 3
items.title: Test automation with Selenium and Playwright
points: Selenium WebDriver with Java or Python
The Page Object Model (POM) for maintainable test code
End-to-end automation with Playwright
Cross-browser and mobile testing strategies with BrowserStack
Reporting with Allure and TestNG or pytest

items.label: Phase 4
items.title: CI/CD, performance and career preparation
points: Performance testing with JMeter and k6
Security testing fundamentals based on OWASP guidance
Running test suites in a GitHub Actions pipeline
A capstone automated test suite for a real application
QA resume, portfolio and interview practice

sections.heading: Why do a software testing internship with Icanio?
sections.intro: Icanio Tech School is the education arm of Icanio Technologies, a Tamil Nadu based AI company trusted by 100+ businesses.
paragraphs: Our mentors are practising Icanio engineers with 3+ years of client delivery, background verified by Icanio HR. In the software testing internship, the person reading your bug reports works with QA on live client releases.

That shapes what you learn. A good defect report is short, reproducible and ranked by impact. A good automation suite is stable, fast and easy to maintain. Your mentor reviews both against internal Icanio standards, not a classroom checklist.

In our experience, QA candidates stand out when they can explain why they tested something, not just how. Every software testing internship at Icanio trains that thinking, with real defects and a real framework as proof.
bullets: Mentors with 3+ years of client delivery experience
Written feedback on test cases, bug reports and scripts
Curriculum refreshed from live project work each cohort
Mock QA interviews and a portfolio review before you finish

sections.heading: What a day in the software testing internship looks like
paragraphs: The day opens with a short stand-up. You share what you tested, which defects you raised and what is blocking you. It is the same rhythm QA teams follow during a release.

Then you test. Early on you might work through a checkout flow with boundary values: zero items, one item, the maximum allowed. Later you turn those checks into Selenium or Playwright scripts, run them across browsers and read the Allure report.

Your mentor reviews your work, often the same day. Feedback is concrete: add the expected result, attach a screenshot, remove this hard-coded wait. You fix it and learn how a professional QA engineer thinks. Part-time interns follow the same loop across evenings or weekends.

faqs.q: Do I need coding skills for software testing?
faqs.a: Not to start. The software testing internship begins with manual testing, which needs logic and clear writing rather than code. Basic Java or Python helps once you reach automation, and your mentor teaches what you need along the way.

faqs.q: How long is the software testing internship?
faqs.a: You choose between 15 days and six months. Short internships cover manual and API testing with a small project. Three and six month internships cover all four phases, including a full automation framework and CI/CD, which makes a much stronger portfolio.

faqs.q: Is the software testing internship offline or online?
faqs.a: Both. You can attend offline at our centre, join online from anywhere in Tamil Nadu, or choose a part-time weekday or weekend batch. Hybrid is also possible, so the software testing internship fits your college timetable.

faqs.q: Will I learn manual testing or automation testing?
faqs.a: Both. You start with manual testing because good automation depends on good test design. Then you move to API automation with Postman and Newman, and UI automation with Selenium and Playwright. By the end you can do either role.

faqs.q: Does the internship prepare me for ISTQB?
faqs.a: Yes. The software testing internship covers the core concepts of the ISTQB Foundation syllabus with focused practice. The exam itself is run separately by ISTQB member boards, and you can book it when you feel ready.

faqs.q: Do I get a certificate after the internship?
faqs.a: Yes. Every intern who completes the software testing internship receives an Icanio Tech School certificate that states the track and duration, along with a portfolio of test suites and reports.

faqs.q: Does the internship help with placement?
faqs.a: We run resume reviews, mock interviews and LinkedIn guidance for every intern, with QA-specific interview practice. Top performers are referred to the Icanio Technologies talent team. Across our programs, 90% of students are placed within five months.

faqs.q: Can my college send a batch of students?
faqs.a: Yes. Many of our 30+ MoU partner colleges send students together, and progress updates can be shared with the placement cell. Ask your placement officer to contact our team, or see our college programs page.
